purpose: Standard visual patterns for comparing Kristal knowledge structures.

patterns.label: Linear
patterns.description: Ordered sequence of steps or transformations.

patterns.label: Branching sequence
patterns.description: Main process with decisions, exception branches and alternate outcomes.

patterns.label: Hub and satellites
patterns.description: A central case connects observations, proofs, state, and supporting documents.

patterns.label: Cluster / constellation
patterns.description: Interconnected clusters without one strict central hierarchy.

patterns.label: Tree / taxonomy
patterns.description: Branching classification from general groups to specific classes.

patterns.label: Timeline
patterns.description: Dated sequence of events, states, revisions or decisions.

patterns.label: Matrix / state table
patterns.description: Compare multiple items across multiple attributes or dimensions.

patterns.label: Casefile
patterns.description: A dossier connects records, notes, evaluations and next actions.

patterns.label: Multilayer
patterns.description: Several analytical layers or interpretations of a related subject.

patterns.label: Network / federation
patterns.description: Autonomous nodes linked by explicit references or coordination relationships.
